description: Extreme close-up low across a polished dark-wood speakeasy bar top, past crystal coupe glasses and brass fixtures, as a bartender's hand pours amber whiskey over a single clear ice sphere. Haze drifts through the frame; magenta neon and amber uplighting reflect in the liquid and glassware. Shallow depth of field. No readable text or logos.
motion: Low gimbal glide along the bar top arriving on the pour, slow motion, liquid swirling around the ice.

description: A smartphone lying face-up on a velvet lounge booth table, its vertical screen glowing with a glossy, over-filtered social media story of soft abstract pink and gold shapes (no readable text, no logos). Behind it, the real lounge: deep indigo haze, magenta neon and warm bokeh of a crowd.
motion: Camera starts directly above the glowing screen, then rolls slowly 180 degrees and rises as the screen's glow blooms and dissolves into the richer real lounge behind it.

description: Intimate tabletop close-up in a warm quiet corner of a lounge: two half-empty cocktail glasses and a flickering candle on dark wood. On the left, a Black woman's hand with warm deep-brown skin, long nude almond nails and a thin gold bracelet; on the right, a Black man's hand with brown skin at the cuff of a charcoal grey suit jacket. The two hands rest a few inches apart, not yet touching. Warm tungsten gold light, everything beyond the table melting into dark bokeh. No faces.
motion: Slow steady push-in at table height as the two hands slowly inch toward each other until the fingertips just touch.

description: Low-angle shot just above an empty rain-slicked city sidewalk at night, puddles mirroring neon magenta and steel-blue streetlights. Two pairs of feet walking in step toward camera: a woman's strappy heels with the hem of a burgundy satin dress beside a man's polished black dress shoes. Light rain, glistening pavement. No faces.
motion: Gimbal skims backward just above the ground as the feet splash softly through the reflections in slow motion, then slow and turn toward each other.

description: View from inside a minimalist apartment through sheer white curtains at a city skyline at the turn from blue hour to sunrise: city lights still twinkling while warm golden light breaks over the rooftops and the curtains glow amber. Soft diffused light, warm creams. No people.
motion: Slow sideways motion-lapse drift along the window as the city lights fade out and golden sunrise light floods in, curtains stirring in a faint breeze.
